title: Specify executable capability, egress, and browser-context policy
description:
Turn the security milestone into executable policy cases rather than another prose threat-model section.

Acceptance criteria:
- Enumerate task-granted tools, origins, recipients, file scopes, and egress classes.
- Define separate untrusted and privileged browser contexts and their credential rules.
- Define which actions require a structured connector, immutable approval, or takeover.
- Add failing scenarios for direct, indirect, encoded, and cross-page prompt injection.
- State explicit v1 exclusions when no enforceable control exists.

comments.author: rap@endymion.com
comments.text: Starting specify slice: executable capability, egress classes, untrusted vs privileged browser contexts, binding controls, injection containment Gherkin, and explicit v1 exclusions. Kernel only; not 53d744 live sinks, not 1e09b4 evals, not 35d86b.
